The '''''Tide of Progress XII''''' was one of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan's]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]].<ref name="ROTSICS" />

==History==
It hailed from a secret [[Unidentified Banking Clan treasury space station|Banking Clan treasury space station]] located halfway between [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and its closest dwarf satellite galaxy.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this vessel served in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]]. It was damaged during the [[Battle of Crombach Nebula/Legends|Battle of Crombach Nebula]] when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wom-Nii Gnaden/Legends|Wom-Nii Gnaden]] crashed his [[NTB-630 naval bomber/Legends|NTB-630 naval bomber]] into it. The damage was still visible when ''Tide of Progress XII'' fought at the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] during the final days of the Clone Wars.<ref name="ROTSICS" />
